questions.question: Which racehorse, trained by Ciaron Maher, won the 2026 Melbourne Cup at Flemington Racecourse?
questions.explanation: Trainer Ciaron Maher achieved a remarkable clean sweep of the top three places in the Melbourne Cup, led by winner Point Of Law.
questions.context: 2026 Melbourne Cup: In thoroughbred racing, Point Of Law, trained by Ciaron Maher, wins the 2026 Melbourne Cup at Flemington Racecourse in Victoria, Australia. Zahrann and Juja Kibo, also trained by Maher, finish second and third respectively.

questions.question: Police in Indonesia made three arrests following allegations that who had their phone wiretapped?
questions.explanation: Three individuals were detained after reportedly tapping the official telephone of President Prabowo Subianto.
questions.context: Three people are arrested for allegedly wiretapping Indonesian president Prabowo Subianto's phone.

readMore.publisher: AFP via South China Morning Post

questions.question: Which political party was projected by news networks to take control of both houses of the US Congress following the midterm elections?
questions.explanation: American major media outlets projected that the Democrats secured enough seats to lead both the Senate and the House of Representatives.
questions.context: 2026 United States elections: U.S. news organizations project that the Democratic Party will control the House of Representatives and the Senate in the upcoming 120th Congress, ending the Republican Party's majority in both chambers.

questions.question: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its benchmark interest rate to 4.85%, reaching its highest level since which year?
questions.explanation: Australia's central bank increased its official rate to 4.85% to combat ongoing inflation, setting a rate not seen since 2008.
questions.context: 2026 Iran war fuel crisis: The Reserve Bank of Australia raises its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage points to 4.85%, its highest level since 2008, citing persistent inflation and rising energy costs associated with the Iran war.

questions.question: Which Spanish author was recently selected to receive the prestigious Cervantes Prize?
questions.explanation: Cristina Fernández Cubas has been honored with the Cervantes Prize, Spanish-language literature's top distinction.
questions.context: Spanish author Cristina Fernández Cubas is awarded the Cervantes Prize.
